signals.title: USD/NOK — G10 Bilateral Theme + Carry
signals.text: USD/NOK trades at 9.553, holding above its SMA20/50 cluster and scoring as the leading G10 bilateral divergence. USD 1W avg sits at +1.812% across 9 pairs while NOK 1W avg sinks to -1.956% across 2 pairs, producing a G10 spread of 3.768%. Fed SOFR at 3.88% versus NOK policy rate at 4.50% yields a 62bp rate differential favoring NOK, yet the currency underperforms heavily alongside a moderate positive ESI of +8.9 and an unemployment surprise shock of +117.01σ. Real rates stand at +1.75% for USD and +1.82% for NOK, keeping both monetary stances restrictive. Technical trend structure shows USD/NOK trading above its rising 20-day and 50-day moving averages at 9.361 and 9.417. Trade bias: Long USD/NOK, structural momentum favoring USD against a weak NOK. Catalyst: Norway inflation and upcoming Norges Bank rate decisions. Risk: NOK strength recovery that compresses the G10 spread below 0.80%.

signals.text: USD/JPY trades at 159.83, holding above its SMA20/50/200 cluster anchored by the 20-day average at 158.13 and 50-day average at 157.34. Options markets show a 25d risk reversal at -1.63, reflecting strong put skew and elevated hedging demand for USD/JPY downside protection. VIX sits at 18.7 under normal volatility while 1-month implied volatility runs at 7.0% against a realized HV30 of 5.4%, generating a positive VRP of +1.5% that indicates an options premium over realized swings. Trade bias: Long USD/JPY, carry differential and crowded speculative shorts sustaining the bid. Catalyst: Next BoJ policy meeting. Risk: VIX breaking above 25 to ignite a disorderly unwind of the carry trade.
